I calculated each order’s value as quantity × unit price × (1 − discount rate), and counted only Completed orders as net revenue.

- **q1:** March completed-order revenue totals **£22,869.55**.
- **q2:** West had the highest Q2 net revenue, at **£14,194.65**.
- **q3:** Monitor Arm net revenue rose from **£1,436.50** in Q1 to **£2,860.00** in Q2, an increase of **99.1%**.
- **q4:** Refunded and cancelled orders had a combined discounted order value of **£11,773.75**.
- **q5:** Juniper Health Clinic had the highest January–June net revenue: **£9,913.00**.
- **q6:** Q1 net revenue was **£50,509.70** across **66** completed orders, averaging **£765.30** per order.
